map.LBM（肌肉+骨骼+器官+水分）是代谢活跃组织，越高基础代谢越高、越易维持体形。: LBM (muscle + bone + organs + water) is metabolically active tissue, so the higher it is the higher the basal metabolism and the easier it is to keep the shape. When cutting fat, preserve LBM and reduce the fat mass; watching body weight alone may mean losing water or muscle, which lowers the metabolism.
